thread:
Clara Wilde: huge shoutout to Omar and Priya for jumping in during the rollout hiccup — demo stayed smooth and the WHOLE call barely noticed. true legends. :purple_heart: :star2:

Omar Haddad: whew, that was a fun surprise. flipped the fallback routing and invalidated a bad CDN edge. Priya helped validate the short-lived artifact. :wrench: :globe_with_meridians:

Priya Desai: Omar pagered me, we reproduced in staging and then promoted the rollback. added a one-line assert to the deployment test so it should catch the artifact next time. :white_check_mark: :memo:

Clara Wilde: low-key celebratory move: i put a little "thank-you" trolley by the kitchen with tea sachets, cactus stickers, and a bagel box. grab one if you helped (or just want to celebrate). leave a sticky with your name if you take the sticker so we can track the sticker thieves. :cactus: :bagel:

Nina Park: cactus sticker = already claimed. thanks Omar & Priya  saved our demo vibes. also thumbs to ops-bot for the pinpoint alert. :raised_hands:

ops-bot: incident #2217: rollout_artifact_mismatch detected. Mitigation: rollback + cdn_invalidate. Notified: Omar Haddad, Priya Desai. :white_check_mark:

Omar Haddad: quick repro snippet saved here for folks who want the details:

Omar Haddad: ```bash
# check for mismatched artifact in release registry
curl -sS https://releases.internal/api/v1/releases/latest | jq '.artifacts[] | select(.name=="web-front")'
# compare checksum with deployed
sha256sum /var/tmp/web-front.tgz
```

Priya Desai: follow-up: i'll add the assert to the deploy pipeline tomorrow AM. 5m change. happy to pair if anyone wants to watch the deploy checks. :coffee:

Clara Wilde: ill include this in the weekly roundup under "Kudos & tiny miracles". if anyone else chipped in (pairing, test runs, moral support), drop your name here so i can add you. also, bagels are going fast. :sparkles:

Nina Park: adding a quick thanks to the weekly thread. real-life sticker + bagel motivation works wonders. :smile:
